messages.subject: Project Willow - amendment & restatement effective today
messages.plaintextBody:
All,

I'm pleased to confirm that the conditions precedent have been satisfied and the Agent has confirmed the Effective Date as today, 22 May 2026. The £4.0m new equity has been received, £2.0m has been applied to prepay Term Loan A (now £12.0m), the £150k amendment fee and WC arrangement fee are settled, and the new £3.0m working-capital facility is available.

Thank you all for a constructive process. We'll circulate the completion bible and attend to post-completion Companies House filings (MR01 for the WC facility security confirmation).

Warm regards

Sarah Whitfield
Partner, Restructuring & Finance
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
Confidential and may be legally privileged.
